# HSR Utility

> HSR Utility builds thoughtfully designed mobile apps for the Muslim community.
> Its first app is Pakiza — HD Islamic wallpapers, status images, and ringtones &
> nasheeds, free on Android. Pakiza is in development and is not yet available on
> the Google Play Store.

## Key facts

- **Studio:** HSR Utility, an independent mobile app studio, founded 2026.
- **App:** Pakiza — a curated collection of HD Islamic wallpapers, shareable status
  images, and ringtones & nasheeds. Core content is free.
- **Platform:** Android 7.0 (Nougat) and above. No iOS version.
- **Status:** Launching soon on Google Play. Not yet released.
- **Contact:** support@hsrutility.com — replies within 48 hours.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hsrutility.com/): HSR Utility and the Pakiza app — features and overview.
- [Support & FAQ](https://hsrutility.com/support/): Answers about Pakiza's content, pricing, Android support, and how to report bugs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hsrutility.com/privacy/): What data Pakiza collects, how it is used, and how it is protected.
- [Delete My Account](https://hsrutility.com/delete-account/): How to permanently delete a Pakiza account and its associated data.
